questions.question: If the quartile deviation of a data set is 30 what will be the new Quartile deviation if 20 is multiplied to each term?
questions.questionHtml: If the quartile deviation of a data set is 30 what will be the new Quartile deviation if 20 is multiplied to each term?
questions.solution:
If all the terms of a data set are multiplied by 20, quartile deviation will also be multiplied by 20.
So, new quartile deviation is 30 * 20 = 600
